name: Radha Rani Gemstone
description: Radha Rani Gemstone offers certified natural gemstones — Ruby, Emerald, Blue Sapphire, Yellow Sapphire — and bespoke luxury jewelry, ethically sourced and lab-tested in India.

scripts.postdeploy: npx prisma db push && npx tsx prisma/seed.ts

DATABASE_URL.description: PostgreSQL database connection string (Supabase / Direct Postgres)

DIRECT_URL.description: Direct PostgreSQL connection string for Prisma migrations

NEXTAUTH_SECRET.description: Secret key used to encrypt NextAuth session tokens

NEXTAUTH_URL.description: Canonical base URL for NextAuth authentication

NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL.description: Public domain URL for site metadata, canonical tags, and OpenGraph images
